props.description: Unit changes reproject saved weather without a source call. Planning wind limits and Explore datasets stay metric.

props.content: In Integrations, install and enable Weather (Open-Meteo). Enable the exact tools you need. App reads require their existing Allow policy; Ask and Off are never bypassed. Core refresh uses weather_forecast and optional air_quality; place search uses geocoding. Explore uses weather_archive, marine_weather and flood_forecast only on explicit reads.

Use Background operation in the header or Operation Center to opt into Keep running. Startup refresh and the hourly app schedule read the core datasets for saved places only while Vakyartha runs and the computer is awake. Manual Refresh is separate. The host owns timing, retries and recovery; playback never schedules source reads.

The connector uses free public weather access for non-commercial use, with service limits and no uptime guarantee. There is no account lookup or paid-key support. Reads older than two hours need refresh; a recent receipt does not make a model estimate a live observation. This app has no radar, push notifications or official emergency-warning feed.
Source reads and failures will appear here. App run receipts are also available in the shared host controls.
